_comment: Forward-nudge demo: zoom in on the lone Spearmen (seed 12345, ~120,232.5, facing south toward the enemy), select it, then tap Up once. Up orders a small fixed FORWARD step that HOLDS the unit's south-facing line -- the regiment steps forward without turning to face the move, mirroring how Down back-steps. Driven live through the real SelectionManager by tools/demo/DemoInputRecorder.gd. World coordinates; physics ticks (60/s).
